attributes.action: Stop the gov changing laws that allow illegal immigrants to gain UK citizenship
attributes.additional_details: Illegal immigrants should not be allowed to apply for citizenship and should not be funded by the govenment to do this.  Sneaking changes to the law is completely unacceptable, Illegal is illegal and criminals should not be able to apply for citizenship under any circumstances.
attributes.background: We need to stop the government making minor changes in the law to allow illegal immigrants to gain citizenship in the UK, and to stop the government funding these applications. Criminals should not be able to apply.

rejection.details:
In accordance with the UK Government's "Good Character requirement", anyone applying for citizenship who previously entered the UK illegally will normally be refused.

You could submit a new petition specifying which changes to the rules you object to.
